name: VC Deal Flow Signal
short_description: Track startup engineering acceleration from public GitHub data.
description: Surface breakout startups before they hit the news. VC Deal Flow Signal tracks commit velocity, contributor growth, and repository expansion across ~400 startup GitHub orgs in 20 sectors. Engineering acceleration has historically preceded fundraise announcements by 3-6 weeks. Free, no auth — backed by an open MCP server with 13 tools, 3 resources, and 7 reusable prompts. Beyond lookups it returns transparent, citable funding-likelihood predictions with full evidence chains (predict_funding), one-call signal shortlists (shortlist_signals), head-to-head comparisons (compare_signals), and public-source diligence dossiers (get_diligence_dossier).

tool_descriptors.name: get_trending_startups
tool_descriptors.summary: Top 20 startups across all sectors by engineering acceleration.

tool_descriptors.name: search_startups_by_sector
tool_descriptors.summary: Sector-filtered ranking. Sector slug from 20 enumerated values.

tool_descriptors.name: get_startup_signal
tool_descriptors.summary: Full signal profile for a named startup.

tool_descriptors.name: get_signals_summary
tool_descriptors.summary: Period, sector and startup counts, last refresh, format URLs.

tool_descriptors.name: get_scout_receipts
tool_descriptors.summary: Compute a Scout Score (0-100) for a GitHub user from their starring history vs. ~75 validated unicorns. Backwards-looking proof of taste.

tool_descriptors.name: get_methodology
tool_descriptors.summary: Methodology document covering data, metrics, classification, limitations.

tool_descriptors.name: predict_funding
tool_descriptors.summary: Transparent, scored funding-likelihood claim for one startup, with the full evidence chain, confidence, caveats, and methodology + SSRN provenance. A citable heuristic, not a black box.

tool_descriptors.name: shortlist_signals
tool_descriptors.summary: The whole sourcing workflow in one call — ranked strongest signals filtered by sector, region, signal type, and score thresholds.

tool_descriptors.name: compare_signals
tool_descriptors.summary: Head-to-head scored comparison of 2-5 named startups with a margin-aware diligence recommendation.

tool_descriptors.name: get_diligence_dossier
tool_descriptors.summary: Public-source diligence dossier for one company in a cited object: M&A history (acquirer, year, amount), funds that publicly backed it, and the published engineering-acceleration signal.

tool_descriptors.name: research_company
tool_descriptors.summary: Paid. Enriched single-company dossier: full signal row, sector rank, and top-5 sector peers.

tool_descriptors.name: compose_thesis
tool_descriptors.summary: Paid. Structured investment-thesis scaffold for a named startup, grounded in signal data.

tool_descriptors.name: deep_dive_scan
tool_descriptors.summary: Paid. Multi-cohort sector scan — breakouts, cooling, and top-by-velocity in one call.

example_prompts: Show me trending startups this week
Who's moving in fintech right now
Find a dark horse in cybersecurity
Is Roboflow likely to raise soon, and what's the evidence?
Shortlist the 5 strongest AI/ML signals in the US
Pull a diligence dossier on Supabase
Draft a one-page deal memo for Roboflow

pricing.rate_limit: no enforced limit on the connector; CDN-fronted
